intro: Rukuru Studio is a branding studio in Malang. We help founders and teams turn an idea into a brand people recognise, remember and choose — from the first strategy session to the last asset.

about.heading: A small studio that thinks before it draws.
body: We started Rukuru because too many good ideas launch with a logo but without a brand. A name, a mark and a colour are only the surface. Underneath sits a decision about who you are for and why anyone should care.
So every project starts with that decision. Once it is clear, the identity, the content and the campaigns follow from it — and stay consistent long after we hand them over.

process.title: Discover
process.body: Workshops, interviews and a look at the market to find what is true and different about you.

process.title: Define
process.body: A positioning, a voice and a brand idea everyone on your team can repeat in one sentence.

process.title: Design
process.body: Identity, type, colour, motion and the first real applications, tested on actual touchpoints.

process.title: Deliver
process.body: Guidelines, templates and launch assets, handed over so your team can keep the brand alive.

title: Strategy
description: Positioning, naming and a brand idea that tells your team what to say yes and no to.

title: Identity
description: Logos, type, colour, motion and the rules that keep them working together everywhere.

title: Content
description: Art direction, photography, social templates and the everyday assets that carry the brand.

title: Campaign
description: Launches and campaigns that introduce the brand with one clear idea across every channel.
